statement: Within the declared exact execution envelope, an integer-dilated elementary source cell has a finite marked patch built by the existing source primitive-neighbor geometry API, retaining fixed octahedral components and original vertex labels; direct and nested refinements agree on finest geometry and original marked vertices without identifying their histories as native particle processes.
algorithm: For source chamber k and D(v)=a+m*v enumerate j_i in [t_i(a)+m*k_i,t_i(a)+m*k_i+m-1] with -sum(j) in {1,2,3}; materialize source items and their fixed components, replay primitive face neighbors and retain source-to-image vertex labels.
mathematical_scope: All positive integer m in the abstract exact-integer construction; the actual Number-based source API is used only inside the implementation's explicit safe execution envelope.
acceptance: Preserve exact source primitive sets, positive cell volumes, full patch connectivity, boundary counts and labelled original vertices; replay actual source face-neighbor calls; verify direct/nested finest patches and original marks; cross-check a parity-colored marked fixture with the existing independent certificate verifier.
falsifier: A missing/extra source primitive, changed fixed subdivision, disconnected target, incorrect marked corner, failed source-neighbor call or inconsistent direct/nested marked geometry.
scope_boundary: No GenerativeAssemblyRules particle packets, phases, PN/NE transfers, new boundary fillers, uniform Ramsey bound or root closure. Alternative geometry histories remain distinct. Prior annotation-preservation theorems are context, not imported proof outcomes.
